e305a01a2ddf.headline: US lawmakers seek Microsoft briefing on reported ByteDance AI deal

claims.claim: A US House panel asked Microsoft to brief lawmakers on a reported deal with ByteDance.
claims.evidence: A US House panel has asked Microsoft to brief lawmakers on a report which said the company could sell AI cloud services to ByteDance...

claims.claim: The reported deal is valued at $500 million and would allow ByteDance to access OpenAI models via Azure.
claims.evidence: Technology news outlet the Information said Microsoft was nearing a $500 million deal that would allow the Chinese firm to use OpenAI models through Microsoft's Azure cloud platform.

claims.claim: Lawmakers expressed concerns that American companies are helping China catch up in the AI race.
The chairman of the House Select Committee on China is John Moolenaar.
claims.evidence: the chairman of the House Select Committee on China , John Moolenaar, said the panel wanted more details...

claims.claim: Microsoft is a Pentagon contractor.
claims.evidence: Moolenaar, a Michigan Republican, said it was unacceptable for Microsoft, as a Pentagon contractor , to sell AI services to ByteDance.

claims.claim: Microsoft is also pursuing deals to sell OpenAI models to other Chinese firms, including Alibaba.
claims.evidence: Microsoft is also pursuing deals to sell OpenAI models to other Chinese businesses, including Alibaba, according to the Information report.
